home.intro: Our home cleaning keeps your apartment or house fresh, hygienic and comfortable, as a regular service or a one-off visit.

areas.title: Kitchen
items: Worktops, hob, sink and taps cleaned
Cabinet fronts and appliance exteriors wiped

areas.title: Bathroom and toilet
items: Shower, bath, sink and taps cleaned and polished

areas.title: Living areas and bedrooms
items: Skirting boards and door frames wiped

areas.title: Entrance hall
items: Shoe area tidied and floor cleaned
Door handles and light switches wiped

home.note: Regular visits are available weekly, every two weeks or monthly. We bring our own equipment and eco-friendly cleaning products.

office.intro: Scheduled office cleaning keeps your workplace tidy, hygienic and welcoming for your team and your visitors.

areas.title: Workspaces and meeting rooms
items: Desks and visible surfaces wiped (papers are left where they are)
Meeting room tables and chairs cleaned
Shelves, window sills and equipment exteriors dusted

areas.title: Kitchens and break rooms
items: Microwave, fridge and coffee machine exteriors wiped

areas.title: Washrooms
items: Toilets, sinks and mirrors cleaned and disinfected
Soap, paper and other supplies refilled

areas.title: Entrance and common areas
items: Reception and corridors vacuumed and mopped
Door handles, light switches and lift buttons disinfected

office.note: We clean outside your business hours, early in the morning or in the evening, so your team is never disturbed. Visits can be daily, weekly or on any schedule that suits you.

moveout.intro: A thorough end-of-tenancy clean that meets the requirements of landlords and housing companies, so you can hand over the keys with confidence.

areas.title: Kitchen
items: Oven cleaned inside, including trays and racks
Fridge and freezer cleaned inside (emptied and defrosted by you)
Hob, extractor hood and filter cleaned

areas.title: Bathroom and sauna
items: Tiles, grout and shower walls cleaned
Sauna benches, walls and floor washed

areas.title: Rooms and storage
items: Doors, door frames, light switches and radiators wiped

areas.title: Windows and balcony
items: Windows washed inside and out where safely accessible
Balcony or patio swept and washed

moveout.note: Before we arrive, please empty the home and defrost the fridge-freezer. If the landlord's or housing company's inspection finds something we missed, we come back and put it right.

window.intro: Streak-free, sparkling windows for homes, shops and offices, inside and out.

areas.title: Windows
items: Openable windows cleaned between the panes where possible

areas.title: Hard-to-reach glass
items: Skylights and high windows with extension poles
Stairwell and atrium windows (where safely accessible)

window.note: Most homes benefit from window cleaning in spring and autumn; shops and offices often prefer a monthly visit. Outdoor work depends on the weather, so we may reschedule in rain or frost.

deep.intro: Deep cleaning goes well beyond a regular clean. It tackles built-up grease, limescale and dust, which makes it ideal after a renovation, before moving in, or whenever a space needs a fresh start.

areas.title: Kitchen
items: Hob, extractor hood and cabinet fronts degreased
Oven, fridge and freezer cleaned inside
Sink and taps descaled and polished

areas.title: Throughout the home
items: Doors, frames, skirting boards and radiators washed
Light fixtures and ceiling corners dusted

areas.title: After renovation
items: Construction dust removed from all surfaces
Paint and plaster splashes removed from glass and tiles
Inside of cupboards and drawers cleaned

deep.note: A deep clean takes longer than a regular visit, so we usually quote based on the size and condition of the space. Photos help us give a precise price.

commercial.intro: Property cleaning for housing companies, property managers and businesses: shared areas kept clean, safe and welcoming for residents and visitors.

areas.title: Stairwells and entrances
items: Entrance doors, glass and mats cleaned

areas.title: Shared facilities
items: Waste rooms and bin shelters washed

areas.title: Seasonal work
items: Seasonal deep cleaning of shared areas
Winter sand and dirt removed from entrances

commercial.note: We agree a cleaning plan and schedule with the property manager or housing company board, so everyone knows what is done and when.
